name: Vaseline Lip Therapy Rosy Lip - 20g
description:
Product details of Vaseline Lip Therapy Rosy Lip – 20g

Product Type: Lip Balm / Lip Therapy

Size: 20g

Origin: Made in Poland

Key Features:

Long-Lasting Moisturization: Helps heal and soothe dry lips

Non-Sticky & Non-Greasy: Smooth, easy application

Delightful Fragrance: Sweet hints of rose, vanilla, and red berry

Light Tint & Gloss: Adds a natural, glossy shine to lips

Healing Formula: Infused with Vaseline Jelly for effective lip care
